t: Nussach beraka shelishit, vedine birkat hammazon beshabbat, vehattoeh bebirkat hammazon
s: Nussach beraka shelishit, vedine birkat hammazon beshabbat, vehattoeh bebirkat hammazon, ubo y"z seipim: achar shechatam "boneh yerushalayim", yaaneh "amen" achar birkat atzmo, mippene shehu siyyum habberakot shel tora. Veap lepi minhag medinot ellu sheen onin "amen" achar birkat atzmo apillu besiyyum berakot — kan tzarik laanot, kede lechalleq ben shalosh berakot shel tora larebiit shehi middibre soperim:

"Amen" zo yomrenna belachash, kede shello yargishu shebberaka rebiit enah min hattora vizalzelu bah. Ubimdinot ellu hamminhag leomro beqol ram. Veyesh meyashshebin hamminhag lomar, shello chasheshu sheyyezalzelu bibraka rebiit ella bimehem, shehayu happoalim holekim limlaktam kesheshshomeim "amen" sheachar "boneh yerushalayim", shello chiyyebu chakamim bibraka rebiit mippene bittul melakto shel baal habbayit, lekak hayu onin "amen" belachash, kede shello yishmeu happoalim (veyakkiru shebberaka rebiit enah min hattora) veyabou lezalzel bah (ap shello bimqom bittul meleket baal habbayit), abal akshayv sheggam happoalim mebarekim arba berakot, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"a — en lachosh lazeh:

Be"boneh yerushalayim", kevan shennizkar bah malkut david — en lehazkir bah malkut shamayim, sheeno derek kabod lehashvotan yachad. Vehaomer "malkuteka umalkut bet david meshicheka" — toeh. Veken en lomar bah: "abinu malkenu". Veyesh omerim sheen lomar gam ken: "melek channun verachum" besiyyum "yaaleh veyabo". Velo nahagu ken, ki lo chasheshu millehazkir malkut shamayim etzel malkut david ella besamuk lah, dehaynu beoto inyan shemmebaqqesh al malkut bet david en lehazkir malkut shamayim samuk lo qetzat (kol oto inyan), al ken en lomar: "abinu malkenu", shehu gam ken samuk lo, ki "veal habbayit ku'" hu inyan echad im malkut bet david, shezzeh taluy bazeh, abal "yaaleh veyabo" hu inyan bipne atzmo, veeno meinyan zeh:

Nussach beraka zo, poteach: "rachem Hashem elohenu", o "nachamenu Hashem elohenu", vechotem "boneh yerushalayim", o "menachem tziyyon bebinyan yerushalayim". Veap al pi sheppatach be"rachem" vechotem bi"menachem" — en lachosh velomar shehachatima enah meinyan happeticha, lepi sheiqqar hachatima kiptichatah mammash, hakkol berachamim. Uben beshabbat uben bechol yesh lomar nussach echad. Velo keotam sheomerim bechol bilshon rachamim ubeshabbat bilshon nechama lepi sheen mebaqqeshim rachamim vetachanunim beshabbat, vetaut hu beyadam, sheggam "nachamenu" hu baqqashat rachamim vetachanunim kemo "rachem". Veen lachosh, shehare omerim: "parnesenu vekalkelenu", veen chosheshin leissur sheelat tzerakayv, lepi shettopes habberaka kak hi. Vegam kol "harachaman" yakol lomar beshabbat ap al pi sheenan mittopes habberaka shettiqqenu chakamim, shekkevan shennahagu hakkol leomram bekol paam shemmebarekin birkat hammazon — naasa lahem ketopes beraka, veen bahem mishshum sheelat tzerakayv beshabbat:

Yesh omerim "reenu", hare"sh bishba"a, shehu leshon baqqasha. Veyesh omerim "roenu becholam", shehu shem hattoar, al shem "Hashem roi". Abal "zunenu", ledibre hakkol omerim bimlapu"m hazzayi"n, shehu leshon baqqasha, kemo "shubenu elohe yishenu", velo bechola"m: "zonenu", beshem hattoar:

Beshabbat veyom tob vechullo shel moed verosh chodesh tzarik lehazkir qedushshat hayyom bebirkat hammazon, sheggam rosh chodesh yesh bo qedushsha, shehare yesh bo qorban musap. Venussach hahazkara, beshabbat: "retzeh vehachalitzenu veku'", ubeyom tob ubechullo shel moed uberosh chodesh: "yaaleh veyabo". Ulepi shehahazkara hi baqqashat rachamim, qebauha bebirkat "boneh yerushalayim", shehi gam ken baqqashat rachamim, velo bebirkat haaretz kemo "al hannissim" bachanukka upurim shehi hodaa. Veim hizkir bebirkat haaretz — lo yatza yede chobato, vetzarik lachazor ulehazkir be"boneh yerushalayim". Veim chal yom tob o chullo shel moed o rosh chodesh beshabbat — omerim techilla "retzeh" veachar kak "yaaleh veyabo", mippene shehashshabbat tadir umequddash mehem. Veeno mazkir shel yom tob o chullo shel moed o rosh chodesh bi"retzeh vehachalitzenu", velo shel shabbat be"yaaleh veyabo", ap ledibre haomerim shebbattepilla mazkir shel shabbat be"yaaleh veyabo", lepi shebbattepilla lo nistayyem adayin inyan shel shabbat qodem "yaaleh veyabo", shehare atid lachtom beshel shabbat, abal bebirkat hammazon kebar nistayyem inyan shel shabbat bi"retzeh vehachalitzenu":

Taa velo hizkir shel shabbat venizkar achar shechatam birkat "boneh yerushalayim" qodem shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" — omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, shennatan shabbatot limnucha leammo yisrael beahaba leot velibrit, baruk atta h' meqaddesh hashshabbat":

Veim taa velo hizkir shel yom tob — omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher natan yamim tobim leammo yisrael lesason ulesimcha, et yom chag peloni hazzeh, baruk atta h' meqaddesh yisrael vehazzemannim". Umi sheeno yodea nussach beraka zo — tzarik lachazor lerosh birkat hammazon, kevan sheeno yodea letaqqen mah sheivvet. Ak im yodea happeticha vehachatima ap sheeno yodea shear hannussach karauy — en tzarik lachazor lerosh bishbil zeh, kevan shehu omer iqqar habberaka, shehu lehazkir shabbat o yom tob babberaka beshem umalkut bappeticha ubeshem lebad bachatima. Veim chal yom tob beshabbat — kolelan yachad veomer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, shennatan shabbatot limnucha leammo yisrael beahaba leot velibrit, veyamim tobim lesason ulesimcha, et yom chag peloni hazzeh, baruk atta h' meqaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael vehazzemannim":

Vekol zeh keshennizkar qodem shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib", shekkevan shemmazkir qedushshat hayyom miyyad achar siyyum "boneh yerushalayim" qodem sheppatach babberaka shelleachareha — hare zeh keillu hizkir qodem siyyum "baruk boneh yerushalayim", shekkol shello patach babberaka shelleachareha — lo niqra siyyum beraka leinyan debarim shemmachazirim oto, kemo shennitbaer besiman qy"d, ella shebbetok "boneh yerushalayim" day behazkara lebaddah belo beraka, kevan shemmazkir betok habberaka, mah sheen ken keshemmazkir achar hachatima tzarik lehazkir bibraka beshem vegam bemalkut, mippene sheenah beraka hassemuka lachabertah, sheenah qebua usemuka lah leolam, ella beaqray keshettaa. Abal im nizkar achar shehitchil "hattob vehammetib", apillu lo amar ella tebat "baruk" bilbad — en lo taqqana behazkara kan, shehi shello bimqomah, vetzarik lachazor lerosh birkat hammazon, sheshshalosh berakot shel birkat hammazon chashubot kibraka achat. Ubekol maqom shettaa bahen taut shemmachazirim oto — chozer lerosh birkat hammazon. Abal beraka rebiit shehi middibre soperim, hi beraka bipne atzmah, veim taa bah taut shemmachazirim oto — eno chozer ella leroshah:

Vekol zeh beshabbat veyom tob shel shalosh regalim, abal bechullo shel moed verosh chodesh verosh hashshana, im lo nizkar ad shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" — eno chozer, mippene shebbirkat hammazon beyamim ellu hi reshut, sheim rotzeh okel perot vekayyotze bahem kede shello yitanneh, uberosh hashshana yesh mattirin apillu lehitannot, veap sheen dibrehem iqqar, mikkol maqom, yesh lachosh ledibrehem shello liknos lispeq beraka lebattala im yachazor lerosh. Mah sheen ken beshabbatot veyamim tobim shel shalosh regalim, shehu chayyab leekol pat shemmebarekin alayv birkat hammazon, shebbeshabbat neemar: "veqarata lashshabbat oneg", ubeyom tob neemar: "vesamachta bechaggeka", veen oneg vesimcha belo akilat lechem (sheqqobeim alayv seuda), shehallechem hu iqqar hasseuda, shekkol seuda niqra al shem hallechem (umine lechamim sheen qobein alehem seuda — tzarik leekol mehem keshiur qebiut seuda, veaz hu chayyab lebarek birkat hammazon, kemo shennitbaer besiman qs"ch [)]. Umikkol maqom, im nizkar qodem shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" berosh chodesh — omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, shennatan rashe chodashim leammo yisrael lezikkaron", vesapeq hu im hu chotem "baruk atta h' meqaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim", im lav, vesapeq beraka lehaqel, velo yachtom. Vaapillu ballayla, shebbitpilla eno chozer im lo amar "yaaleh veyabo" baaboda, ap al pi shennizkar qodem shehitchil beraka shelleachareha — bebirkat hammazon tzarik lomar: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, shennatan veku'", lepi shebbattepilla kevan sheap shello nizkar ad shehitchil "modim" lo hitzrikuhu lachazor laaboda lehazkir shel rosh chodesh bemaqom shettiqqenu chakamim lepi sheen meqaddeshin hachodesh ballayla — en lo lehazkir gam ken ben aboda lemodim, mishshum hepseq battepilla, abal bebirkat hammazon achar shechatam "boneh yerushalayim" — nistayyema birkat hammazon shel tora, veen lachosh lehepseq im yebarek: "asher natan ku'" qodem sheyyatchil "hattob vehammetib". Veap sheen machazirim oto mishshum hazkarat rosh chodesh ballayla, mikkol maqom, zo enah chazara ella hosapat beraka, shettiqqenu lehosip bemaqom sheen lachosh bah lehepseq:

Veken bechullo shel moed omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher natan moadim leammo yisrael lesason ulesimcha, et chag peloni hazzeh", veeno chotem. Uberosh hashshana omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher natan yamim tobim leammo yisrael, et yom hazzikkaron hazzeh", veeno chotem. Veeno omer: "lesason ulesimcha". Vecholeh sheakal beyom hakkippurim omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam, asher natan yamim qedoshim leammo yisrael, et yom hakkippurim hazzeh", veeno chotem. Veim lo nizkar ad shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" — eno chozer, shehare en birkat hammazon choba lo mechamat qedushshat hayyom ella mechamat cholyo. Veyesh omerim shebberosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim chotem kemo beshabbat veyom tob. Berosh hashshana omer: "baruk atta h' meqaddesh yisrael veyom hazzikkaron", velo "melek al kol haaretz". Velo yomar: "udebareka emet veqayyam laad" qodem hachatima, kemo sheomer bahaptora ubaqqiddush, shehare beraka zo enah choba mishshum qedushshat hayyom ella bimqom hazkara beolma shebb"yaaleh veyabo". Ubeyom hakkippurim omer: "baruk atta h' meqaddesh yisrael veyom hakkippurim". (Veap al pi sheen birkat hammazon choba lahem — en zeh monea hachatima, kemo sheeno monea happeticha, mittaam shennitbaer. Velo maneu hachatima berosh chodesh ella mippene shekkevan sheen bo qedushsha leesor asiyyat melaka, veken shear mitzvot hannohagot bekol "miqra qodesh" enan nohagot bo, ella qorban musap bilbad — yesh lomar sheen lachtom bo "meqaddesh yisrael verashe chodashim" ella bitpillat musap bilbad, abal bebirkat hammazon day behazkarato lebad kemo bishar tepillot. Mah sheen ken berosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shehem "miqrae qodesh", ubekol hattepillot chotemin bahen "meqaddesh" — chotem gam ken bebirkat hammazon. Veen tzarik lomar bisuda g' o d' shel shabbat, shechotem ap al pi sheen choba leekol pat, kemo sheyyitbaer. Uleinyan halaka, ap al pi shessepeq berakot lehaqel, hassomek al sebara acharona vechotem — lo hipsid, sheap berosh chodesh yesh omerim lachtom, veen omerim sepeq berakot lehaqel, lepi shemmin hassetam en leshannotah mibbeshabbat veyom tob. Uberosh hashshana, yesh lomar shehakkol modim sheen leshannotah mishshear yamim tobim, shello chillequ chakamim bibraka achat lomar paam kullah upaam miqtzatah, shemmittaam zeh potachat birkat haqqiddush be"baruk" ap al pi shehi semuka lebirkat hayyayin, lepi shellipamim en tzarik lebarek al hayyayin, kegon sheyyosheb bisuda mibbeod yom, lekak hitzriku leolam liptoach haqqiddush bibraka, shello lechalleq bibraka achat. Abal berosh chodesh eno mebarek otah beraka shemmebarek beshabbat veyom tob, shehare poteach: "asher natan rashe chodashim ku'", mah sheen ken berosh hashshana sheppoteach: "asher natan yamim tobim veku'" kebishar yamim tobim, ushear hannussach eno meakkeb kelal, kemo shennitbaer lemala bisip [ch']. Veen tzarik lomar bisuda g' o d' shel shabbat veyom tob, sheppoteach beoto nussach mammash shebbisudot rishonot). Veyesh omerim shecholeh sheakal beyom hakkippurim eno mazkir kelal shel yom kippur bebirkat hammazon apillu lekattechilla, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"ch. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem, shello liknos lispeq beraka lebattala, velo yebarek kelal birkat "asher natan ku'", im shakach lomar "yaaleh veyabo":

Berosh chodesh vechullo shel moed, im lo nizkar ad shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" sheeno chozer — en nohagin lomar "yaaleh veyabo" betok "harachaman" kemo shennohagin be"al hannissim", lepi shebb"yaaleh veyabo" yesh bo hazkarat shemot, velo ratzu leomram shello letzorek, ap al pi sheen issur baddabar, shehare omerim kol hayyom techinnot ubaqqashot sheyyesh bahen hazkarat shemot, velo aseru ella lehazkir hashshem lebattala o bibraka sheenah tzerika:

Rosh chodesh shechal beshabbat velo hizkir lo shel shabbat velo shel rosh chodesh venizkar qodem shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" — kolel rosh chodesh im shabbat veomer: "shennatan shabbatot limnucha verashe chodashim lezikkaron", vechotem: "baruk atta h' meqaddesh hashshabbat veyisrael verashe chodashim", shehare ap berosh chodesh lebad sapeq im chotem, ella shessepeq beraka lehaqel, abal kan shemmebarek bishbil hashshabbat — kolel immo gam rosh chodesh. Abal im lo shakach ella shel shabbat lebad — omer: "baruk shennatan shabbatot ku'", veeno kolel shel rosh chodesh:

Im hizkir shel shabbat velo hizkir shel rosh chodesh velo nizkar ad achar shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib" — eno chozer lerosh, sheap shechayyab leekol pat — en chiyyub zeh ella mishshum shabbat, abal berosh chodesh en chiyyub hazkara leolam sheyyitchayyeb lebarek birkat hammazon ulehazkir, vahare zeh domeh lemaptir benabi berosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat, sheen mazkir shel rosh chodesh, hoil veen haptora berosh chodesh leolam. Veim hizkir shel rosh chodesh velo shel shabbat, keshechozer lerosh birkat hammazon — tzarik lehazkir gam shel rosh chodesh lekattechilla, shebbekol birkat hammazon tzarik lehazkir shel rosh chodesh ap sheeno mebarek bishbil rosh chodesh. Abal beshabbat chanukka im hizkir shel chanukka velo hizkir shel shabbat vechozer lerosh — en tzarik lehazkir shel chanukka, mippene shehazkarat chanukka enah choba kelal bebirkat hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman trp"b:

Seuda shelishit beshabbat dina kerosh chodesh, sheeno chozer im hitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib", lepi sheyyesh omerim shesseuda g' en tzarik pat, veap sheen dibrehem iqqar, mikkol maqom, yesh lachosh ledibrehem shello liknos lispeq beraka lebattala. Ubisuda g' beyom tob, ledibre hakkol eno chozer, shehare enah ella reshut. Umikkol maqom, im nizkar qodem shehitchil birkat "hattob vehammetib", apillu bisuda rebiit beshabbat veyom tob — omer: "baruk shennatan shabbatot ku'", o "shennatan yamim tobim ku'", kemo sheomer berosh chodesh ap al pi sheen tzarik pat kelal beoto yom, vekol seudotayv, apillu harishona, en lah illuy yoter misseuda harebiit shel shabbat:
Shelosha sheakelu beshabbatot veyamim tobim vezimmenu, veshakechu lehazkir meen hammeora, vehem tzerikim lachazor lerosh birkat hammazon — yebareku kol echad leatzmo, ki mide zimmun kebar yatzeu:

Haya okel beshabbat venimsheka seudato ad shechasheka, apillu kamma shaot ballayla — mazkir shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon, lepi shehakkol holek achar hatchalat hasseuda, sheaz chal alayv chiyyub hazkara meen hammeora, velo nipqa mimmennu chiyyub zeh bitziat hayyom. Vehu haddin lerosh chodesh chanukka upurim. Veyesh omerim shebberosh chodesh chanukka upurim hoil veen bahem tosepet mechol al haqqodesh — eno mazkir meen hammeora achar sheyyatza hayyom. Veen nohagin ken. Umikkol maqom, im nimsheka seudato beereb shabbat o beereb rosh chodesh tok hallayla — tzarik lehazkir shel shabbat o shel rosh chodesh im akal kezayit mishshechasheka, ap al pi shebbitchillat hasseuda haya patur millehazkir, lepi shemmikkol maqom chal alayv chiyyub hahazkara baakilat kezayit shemmishshechasheka. Vehu haddin lachanukka upurim. Veyesh omerim sheapillu lo akal kezayit mishshechasheka tzarik lehazkir, kevan shebbeshaa shemmebarek kebar qiddesh hayyom shel shabbat o yom tob o rosh chodesh chanukka upurim. Veken im nimsheka seudato beshabbat o rosh chodesh chanukka upurim ad hallayla, ap al pi sheggomra mibbeod yom ella shemmebarek ballayla — eno mazkir meen hammeora (shel oto hayyom), kevan shekkebar pana hayyom. Venohagin kassebara harishona. Vehu shello hitpallel arbit, ap al pi shehatztzibbur hitpallelu kebar, abal im hitpallel arbit, apillu mibbeod yom, beemtza seudato — shub eno mazkir meen hammeora shel oto hayyom, apillu mebarek gam ken mibbeod yom. Veen tzarik lomar mi shennimsheka seudato lemotzae shabbat vehitpallel arbit, sheeno mazkir od shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon. Veap al pi shellisbara rishona shehakkol holek achar hatchalat seuda haya rauy lehazkir gam achar tepillat arbit, mikkol maqom, yehe nireh sheddebarayv soterim zeh et zeh, shettechilla hitpallel tepillat yom shelleacharayv veachar kak mazkir yom heabar. (Mikkol maqom, im lo hitpallel arbit umotzae shabbat hu rosh chodesh — mazkir shel shabbat vegam shel rosh chodesh im akal kezayit mishshechasheka, veen kan setira, kevan shemmazkir shel shabbat techilla veachar kak shel rosh chodesh. Veap al pi shei epshar lomar shemmeqabbel alayv rosh chodesh akshayv keshemmazkiro achar shehizkir kebar shabbat, shehare mequbbal veomed hi mishsheshshoqa hachamma, vegam im haya meqabbelo akshayv lo chal alayv chiyyub hahazkara akshayv ella kesheakal kebar qodem shehizkir shel shabbat — en lachosh lekol zeh, sheap shechal alayv rosh chodesh kebar — mazkir hu shel shabbat kemo shemmazkir meen hammeora bekol motzae shabbat umotzae rosh chodesh, apillu kamma shaot ballayla, shekkebar chalap vehalak lo yom shemazkir, hoil vehatchalat hasseuda hayeta bo. Veap al pi shennireh lekol haolam shehu layla — en zo setira kol shehu lo asa kebar dabar hassoter lazeh. Vehu haddin bemotzae shabbat lerosh chodesh, keshemmazkir shel shabbat lo asa adayin dabar hassoter lazeh, veachar kak keshemmazkir shel rosh chodesh haemet hu shehu mazkir). Veyesh omerim sheap al pi ken zo setira hi, velaken mazkir shel rosh chodesh shehi choba ledibre hakkol velo shel shabbat shehi machaloqet. Abal bemotzae shabbat shel chanukka upurim mazkir shel shabbat velo shel chanukka upurim, lepi shekkol yom sheen bo qorban musap en hazkarato choba bebirkat hammazon, kemo sheyyitbaer siman trp"b (ayyen leel sy"d) vtrtz"h. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Veim mishshechasheka lo akal kezayit pat, ledibre hakkol mazkir shabbat lebad, kol shello hitpallel arbit. Veim hibdil al shulchano — dino kehitpallel arbit, veshub eno mazkir shel shabbat bebirkat hammazon. Veim amar "hammabdil ben qodesh lechol" bilbad belo kos, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rtz"t — yesh lehistappeq (ulepi mah shennitbaer kan — en kan sapeq, delo gara mehazkarat rosh chodesh) im dino kehitpallel arbit. Ulepikak, sheb veal taaseh adip, shehare yesh omerim shelleolam eno mazkir shel shabbat achar sheyyatza hayyom:
